notes: No kb/Work note owns the fix (none found for the conditional-phrase order at 85). §1985:VI.6.8.2 prints COMPUTE, one or more {identifier-1 [ROUNDED]}, =, arithmetic-expression-1, then [ON SIZE ERROR imperative-statement-1], then [NOT ON SIZE ERROR imperative-statement-2], then [END-COMPUTE]. The superset rule computeStatement (computeStore+ EQUALS arithmeticExpression conditionalPhrases END_COMPUTE?) parses it and ArithmeticBinder.BindCompute binds it at every edition; what later editions add is refused at --std 85, probed: ROUNDED MODE IS by VisitRoundedPhrase (COBOL0803), the boolean format's operators by VisitComputeStatement (GateBooleanOperators), EQUAL for = (no grammar arm, COBOL0001), a repeated ON or NOT ON SIZE ERROR phrase by the association predicate (COBOL2269); a missing receiver or expression does not parse, and ON, the optional word, may be omitted. PARTIAL for one arm: the printed sequence of the two phrases is not enforced. conditionalPhrases is ({conditionalPhraseAssociates($ctx)}? conditionalPhrase)* and ConditionalPhraseAssociation.Associates tests only that a phrase is printed by a format of the statement and not yet written, with no edition arm for the order, so NOT ON SIZE ERROR written before ON SIZE ERROR compiles and runs at 85. §1985:IV.2.1 makes the sequence part of the format ("Clauses must be written in the sequence given in the general formats."); the any-order reading is the 2002 change (§2002:F.2 item 33), and the row's own change record names it as what 2023 accepts and 1985 fixes. The mechanism is the one grammar loop and predicate shared by every statement with a conditional-phrase pair. The witness runs the printed order only (two receivers, one ROUNDED, both phrases, END-COMPUTE).

next.reason: 1985: "{identifier-1 [ROUNDED]} … [ON SIZE ERROR imperative-statement-1] [NOT ON SIZE ERROR imperative-statement-2]"; 2023: "{ identifier-1 [ rounded-phrase ] } … choice indicators: ON SIZE ERROR / NOT ON SIZE ERROR in any order; ROUNDED MODE IS". 2023 accepts the SIZE ERROR phrases in either order where 1985 fixed ON before NOT, adds ROUNDED MODE IS options and a boolean COMPUTE format: more programs accepted.
